en: Sword of Slaying Everything Except Squid
name: Меч убийства всего, кроме кальмаров
alt: Грозный меч бессильно гнётся рядом с самодовольным маленьким кальмаром.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, readable at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky simple forms, strong silhouette. Large centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery, one visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, border, card frame or panels. Original composition, do not copy existing card art. Clear anatomy, no duplicated limbs. Subject: One magnificent broad silver fantasy sword with a blue leather grip and golden crossguard, displayed diagonally. The steel tip bends away comically like soft rubber from a small smug lavender squid sitting beside it; the squid has two large eyes, eight short arms and two longer tentacles naturally clustered under its body. Visual joke that a mighty sword is scared of a harmless squid. No human figures, no text, no extra weapons.
